notes.title: Blackwell Convergence - Smallest patch
notes.notes: Basically we've added the ability to change from skipping speech automatically and with keypresses to only when you keypress if u press "CTRL+P", that state is global, and persists between your savegames.

notes.title: Blackwell Convergence - Engine Patch
notes.notes:
Hi,

We're upgrading the game to 3.6 version of AGS, which basically means better rendering, better support for resolutions and better support for keyboard and mice!

The savegames have been tested and should work, and shouldn't break.
If for any reason there's an issue, feel free to report and opt in to beta oldversion, by using the password "oldversionold"

notes.title: Blackwell Convergence is on STEAMDECK!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3955462/86d12cdbab9bab0b6affa94c9a78ae0233d6062b.png[/img]
Blackwell Convergence is Steamdeck verified!!

We're only missing Blackwell Unbound atm, and we'll have the whole family of the Blackwell games approved! All the steamdeck builds of all the Wadjet Eye Games, allow YOUR saves to be moved from your Operating System to Steamdeck and viceversa. Due to the nature of the engine (AGS), we decided allowing people to take their progress everywhere, was our first priority. So the adjustments that all these games have, are focused in functionality!

notes.title: Blackwell Convergence v1.8 - Mac And Linux Ports are back.
notes.notes:
- Added proper LINUX and MAC ports with WORKING ACHIEVEMENTS!
- Added a small music volume drop when speech occurs to give more breathing room.
- Music now starts at 75% [To help accomodate things].
- Added (F2 and F3) as music volume controls [speech is already at 100%, also was before and imho doesn't need to be adjusted]
- Added + and - as MASTER Volume controls.
- Fixed few crash bugs.
- Fixed a bug regarding looking at close ups when a certain individual was around.
- Older savegames will load and play fine, but there are some small music related issues, specifically: The music WILL BE being unaffected by volume set through f2 and f3 when transitioning between rooms, BUT will revert to the value set after the transition is complete. This bug can only be solved by starting over, but you don't specifically need to.

notes.title: Small update for 4/11
notes.notes:
PUshed a small fix regarding the last line of Frank's film script going over the bottom of the screen. It won't break saves, but if you've already seen the script it in-game [i]may[/i] not update properly. 

If it doesn't, the last line of the script is "I'm staying here with Tom."

notes.title: Blackwell Convergence update!
notes.notes:
Hello all! You might have noticed that Blackwell Convergence has been updated (along with all the other Blackwell games) . We have re-compiled the entire game in the newest version of the Adventure Game Studio engine. This means that the game NOW WORKS ON ALL YOUR FANCY NEW MODERN MONITORS. As the game got older, many glitches started appearing. Those should - theoretically - be gone now. We know this update was a long time in coming. Thank you for your patience.

This does have the negative effect of breaking all your original save files. If you would like to revert back to the original version of the game, you need to to the following:

1- Right-click on the game in your Steam library
2- Select "Properties" and go to the "Beta" tab
3- Enter the password "oldblackwellconvergence"
4- select the beta version "original" from the drop down list.

The game should revert itself back to the old version. If it doesn't, uninstall and reinstall.

Thank you all, and enjoy the game!

-Dave & Janet

notes.title: Blackwell Series Update Released
notes.notes: We have upgraded the Steam integration DLL which fixes an incompatibility issue with the latest version of the Steam client that stopped achievements from unlocking.  With this new upgrade, all Blackwell achievements will now unlock properly.

In a city so full of life, who has time for the dead?
